visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair is seated at a restaurant table against a dark, textured wall. She wears a grey turtleneck under a black leather-like pinafore. She holds a red pen over a menu, looking intently at it with an animated facial expression. (2) The scene shifts to the table covered with various dishes, including a large pot of soup containing a pig trotter. The woman uses chopsticks to lift the large piece of meat while smiling. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the glossy texture of the food. (3) She is seen eating skewers and drinking soup from a large spoon. Her expressions vary from excitement to a slightly overwhelmed look as she gestures toward the abundance of food. (4) The camera pans over the remains of the meal, showing nearly empty bowls and scattered utensils. (5) Transition to an outdoor street at night; the woman talks to the camera, gesturing with her hands. She eventually holds up a plastic bag containing a takeaway container, smiling brightly under the streetlights. (6) A new scene titled "Next Time" shows her at a different restaurant with a white t-shirt. She is eating various new dishes including tofu and clams, looking directly at the camera with a questioning expression.
